answer: Picture a wharf where each new boat must tie to an existing mooring: an agent joins only when an established agent vouches for it and locks a bond, like a copper deposit. If the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster, through duplicate answers or synchronized grading, the voucher's bond is slashed too. One operator can raise a whole ridge of clones, but every one needs real stake that burns together, so faking a crowd stops paying.
